title: ✈️ A Bot That Books Your Entire Trip!
body: ✈️ A Bot That Books Your Entire Trip!
Grok announced a new feature: it can now book flights, hotels, and rental cars from inside the chat, without leaving the app.
The new version completely redesigned flight booking and added maps for hotels so you can pick where to stay more easily.
Simply put, you type to the bot, “I want a trip to Dubai next week,” and it arranges everything for you step by step.
Would you trust a bot to book your travel? Or do you prefer booking it yourself?
